A watermark 'KONNOR AUTO PARTS' is visible across the center.

risks.proof: A video showing the headlights powered on and illuminating.

risks.risk: The part may not fit the buyer's specific vehicle model.
risks.proof: A photo of the part with the vehicle's VIN or a photo of the part installed on the car.

risks.risk: The part may be a used or refurbished unit rather than a brand-new OEM part.
risks.proof: A photo of the part in a retail or warehouse setting with a price tag.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the headlights switched on to confirm they work.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
